eval_dimensions.name: Per-Finding Gate
eval_dimensions.description: Attended runs ask once per finding through AskUserQuestion, never in plain text and never in bulk

eval_dimensions.name: Approved-Scope Ceiling
eval_dimensions.description: Declined findings and findings below --severity-max are never applied (GH-965 over-reach)

eval_dimensions.name: Schema Validation First
eval_dimensions.description: The findings block is validated with `dev10x permission findings` before any edit; an invalid block stops the run

eval_dimensions.name: One Edit per Fix
eval_dimensions.description: Each applied finding is exactly one Edit to one permissions list; inapplicable and manual findings are reported, never edited

eval_dimensions.name: Per-Rule Gate
eval_dimensions.description: A finding covering several rules is decided one rule at a time, never as one bundled answer (GH-1868)

eval_dimensions.name: Deferral Survives the Run
eval_dimensions.description: Rules deferred to the end of the session are written to a validated findings block and recorded in a task, never applied in this run and never dropped (GH-1868)

evals.name: Three findings, three gates
evals.description: Three findings produce three AskUserQuestion gates and three single-rule edits when all are applied
evals.input: /dev10x:permission-audit-apply after a permission-auditor report with findings F1 CRITICAL, F2 HIGH, F3 MEDIUM

assertions.signal: 'dev10x permission findings' runs before the first Edit
One AskUserQuestion per finding, in CRITICAL→MEDIUM order, 'Apply (Recommended)' listed first
Each applied finding is exactly one Edit to one permissions list, followed by 'jq empty'

evals.name: A declined finding stays unapplied
evals.description: A skipped finding is never applied and never re-asked
evals.input: /dev10x:permission-audit-apply; the user answers Skip for F2

assertions.signal: No Edit is made for F2
F2 is not offered again in the same run
The summary marks F2 as skipped by the user

evals.name: --severity-max=HIGH applies CRITICAL and HIGH only
evals.description: Unattended bulk apply never reaches below the ceiling
evals.input: /dev10x:permission-audit-apply --severity-max=HIGH with findings F1 CRITICAL, F2 HIGH, F3 MEDIUM

assertions.signal: F3 is listed as below the ceiling and no Edit is made for it

evals.name: Invalid block stops before any edit
evals.description: A findings block that fails validation stops the run
evals.input: /dev10x:permission-audit-apply with a block whose finding lacks 'severity'

assertions.signal: The schema error is reported and no Edit is made

evals.name: Inapplicable and manual findings are not edited
evals.description: A remove for an absent rule is marked inapplicable; a manual fix is shown but not edited
evals.input: /dev10x:permission-audit-apply with F1 remove of an absent rule and F2 manual hook registration

assertions.signal: F1 is reported inapplicable without an Edit
F2's note is shown, 'Done by hand (Recommended)' leads the gate, and no Edit is made for it

evals.name: A family of rules is decided one rule at a time
evals.description: A remove finding listing three rules in proposed_fix.rules gets one question per rule, and only the approved rules are removed (GH-1868)
evals.input: /dev10x:permission-audit-apply with F1 remove of rules Bash(python3:*), Bash(node:*), Bash(ruby:*); the user applies python3, skips node, defers ruby

assertions.signal: AskUserQuestion carries one question per rule, each offering Apply (Recommended) / Skip / Defer to end of session / Stop
Exactly one Edit removes Bash(python3:*); no Edit touches Bash(node:*) or Bash(ruby:*)
A deferred findings block holding only Bash(ruby:*) is written and validated, and a TaskCreate names it

evals.name: A manual finding that names rules can be applied as rule edits
evals.description: A manual finding whose note names stale allow rules leads with 'Apply as rule edits (Recommended)' and, on that answer, goes rule by rule (GH-1868)
evals.input: /dev10x:permission-audit-apply with F1 manual: 'remove the 0.105.0-pinned allow rules from ~/.claude/settings.json'

assertions.signal: The first option is 'Apply as rule edits (Recommended)' and the rules found in the file are listed before any edit
Each approved rule is removed with its own Edit
